import json,subprocess,sys
from pathlib import Path
import a_sync
from mypy import version
completed=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-P','-m','mypy'],capture_output=True,text=True)
report=Path('/reports')
(report/'mypy-stdout.txt').write_text(completed.stdout)
(report/'mypy-stderr.txt').write_text(completed.stderr)
(report/'mypy-result.json').write_text(json.dumps({'exit_code':completed.returncode,'mypy_version':version.__version__,'plugin_dependency':a_sync.__file__})+'\n')
print('\n'.join(completed.stdout.splitlines()[-2:]))
print(completed.stderr[-500:])
raise SystemExit(completed.returncode)
